Prevalence of the APA by age bracket, France, 2010-2024

Source: R/data.R
FRAPAprevalence.Rd

Number of beneficiaries and prevalence (share in the population) of the APA (allocation personnalisee d'autonomie, the French benefit for older people with long-term care needs), for all GIR (levels of loss of autonomy) and all places of residence (at home and in institutions), by age bracket. The data come from the annual survey 'Aide sociale' of the DREES, compiled in the package 'asdep' (version of january 2026, data up to 31 december 2024).

Usage

FRAPAprevalence

Format

A data frame with 162 observations and 7 variables:

year

year (31 december)

decomp

decomposition of ages: 6 or 8 age brackets

agebracket

label of the age bracket (for example "[70,75)" for 70 to 74 years old)

age

minimum age of the age bracket

nb

number of beneficiaries of the APA in the age bracket

pop

total population in the age bracket

prevalence

prevalence of the APA in the age bracket (between 0 and 1)

Source

http://www.data.drees.sante.gouv.fr/

Details

Two decompositions of ages above 60 are available, identified by variable 'decomp': 6 brackets (5-year brackets up to 85, then 85 and over), available for 2010 to 2024, and 8 brackets (5-year brackets up to 95, then 95 and over), available for 2016 to 2024. Total figures for all GIR are those recalculated as the sum of the numbers by GIR. Prevalences by age bracket can be converted to prevalences by single year of age with ApproxPrevalenceTable.
